theory: The uniform-depth volume and capacity fact extends beyond this skill's supplied teaching and question types and should be removed. Qualify the claim that more applications give a closer estimate as the usual benefit of following a curved boundary more closely, rather than a guarantee for arbitrary boundaries; additional samples alone cannot establish which estimate is closer.
summary: Replaced unsupported unknown-offset, volume, capacity and three-or-four-application tasks with cited one-or-two-application area estimates, retaining their locators, tiers and quiz ids, and repaired the q2 and q3 distractors. Removed the accuracy-comparison request and categorical conclusion from development[2], removed the volume-and-capacity theory fact, and qualified the benefit of more applications while preserving all unaffected content.
reviewSummary: All 17 scoped items use booklet question types, remain focused on the target skill, and have correct working and answers. The theory is mathematically sound, and every reviewed quiz has exactly one correct option with distractor values matching their stated mistakes.
